description: This file defines 'ContentActivity', an Android activity class that manages UI state related to theme and content placeholders, and interacts with 'ContentFragment' to update displayed content based on intent extras.

classes.name: ContentActivity
classes.description: An activity that hosts a ContentFragment and manages theme and content updates based on intent extras and saved instance state.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, restores theme from intent extras or saved state, sets layout, and updates content fragment with category and position.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current theme ID to the instance state bundle for restoration.
